summary: WinVest Acquisition Corp., a Delaware blank-check company trading on OTC Markets, filed an 8-K after a September 15, 2026 special meeting where stockholders approved a trust amendment extending the trust liquidation date from September 17, 2026 to October 17, 2026, with up to five additional one-month extensions to March 17, 2027 at $30,000 per extension. The company and Continental Stock Transfer entered the amendment September 16, 2026, alongside a $180,000 unsecured Sponsor promissory note. The sponsor loan is non-interest bearing and matures at business-combination closing or liquidation; watch for further extensions, trust redemptions, and deal announcement timing.
